name: The Mute
source:
You are Doctor Bezmolvniy, a Capitolian Healer, who is practicing medicine in various spheres. Your career goes calmly and steadily, until one day, you receive a letter from the Officials. It says that you must visit a nearby country.

Why?          

To participate in a recent investigation on several deaths, caused by an unknown drug.

No details included.

Nothing unusual, one might think. But, if only you could have known, that after this particular business trip your life would never be the same…
